channel.description: AI from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
item.description: Claude formally proved security properties in the compiled code of 123 open-source libraries. Along the way, it found bugs that had eluded detection for years. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Study Finds AI-generated Code Fails to Boost Productivity Due to Downstream Bottlenecks
item.description: A recent Harvard study of 718 firms, using the Jellyfish analytics platform, finds that although AI coding assistants and agents increase code volume, this does not translate into a corresponding increase in completed work, partly because… (1 source: infoq)

item.title: OpenShell – A safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents
item.description: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents. - NVIDIA/OpenShell (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Anthropic Adds Opt-In Security Scanning for Critical Open-Source Projects
item.description: AI company Anthropic has launched OSS Scanner, a free, opt-in service to find vulnerabilities in open-source projects. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: Move Fast, Don’t Break Trust: Shipping Constantly with Humans and Beyond
item.description: Suhail Patel discusses how Monzo structures its software engineering organization and technical stack to ship safely hundreds of times a day. (1 source: infoq)
